name: Colosse Colossae
overview: The city of Colossae in Phrygia is highlighted in Scripture as a community of faithful believers in Christ, to whom grace and peace are extended from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. The believers there are commended for their love in the Spirit, a testimony brought by Epaphras, a devoted minister of Christ who faithfully served them. These verses emphasize the close relationship between the Colossian saints and their spiritual leaders, grounded in Christ-centered faith and mutual love.
